properties.findings: All workspace tests pass (exit 0, both crates), clippy clean on core and mcp, fmt clean, schema validates, skill_lint green, 155 toolsnaps regenerated with exactly one changed. Both trial arms reproduced through the shipped binary after the change: mature 23/29 node types, 42/61 edge types, 155/178 node properties, 59/81 edge properties, 70 items on request; day-one 101 items on request with 13 of them properties, default reply 2973 bytes. The list grew by 126% on the mature arm and 15% on the day-one one — the asymmetry `fact:naming-properties-grows-the-list-where-it-can-be-acted-on` records, and the reason naming properties did not re-create the noise the fourth trial decision was taken to avoid.
properties.name: Eleven probes — one per decision the two-arm trial made, plus the five that keep the property naming honest — so a later session cannot quietly undo one without a red test
